parameters.selection: two tallest complete boxes on each court half; ambiguous or missing sides are not imputed
parameters.motion_anchor: mean visible hips, confidence>=0.35; missing hips are not stationary; link hips, not arm-dependent box center
parameters.caution: Fixed-camera development heuristic; box-bottom homography used only as a coarse ROI, not physical position ground truth. Offline gesture/audio proposals use future context.
